tools.name: get_bookmarked_movies
tools.title: Get Bookmarked Movies
tools.description: Fetch the authenticated user's bookmarked movies with save dates and poster URLs.

limit.description: Maximum number of movies to return (default 20).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call.

tools.name: add_bookmark
tools.title: Add Bookmark
tools.description: Add a movie to the authenticated user's bookmarks. Use search_movies first when you only have a title.

movieId.description: Firebase movie id for the movie to bookmark.

tools.name: set_watched
tools.title: Set Watched
tools.description: Mark a movie as watched for the authenticated user. Use search_movies first when you only have a title.

movieId.description: Firebase movie id for the movie to mark as watched.

tools.name: search_movies
tools.title: Search Movies
tools.description: Search the KinElo movie catalogue by title. Use this to find a movieId before calling get_movie_details.

limit.description: Maximum number of movie hits to return (default 10).

tools.name: get_rated_movies
tools.title: Get Rated Movies
tools.description: Fetch the authenticated user's rated movies with Elo, dates, and poster URLs.

limit.description: Maximum number of movies to return (default 20).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call.

sort.description: Sort order for rated movies. Defaults to elo.

tools.name: get_recommended_movies
tools.title: Get Recommended Movies
tools.description: Fetch the authenticated user's personalized movie recommendations.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return (default 20).

tools.name: get_global_leaderboard
tools.title: Get Global Leaderboard
tools.description: Fetch the top global movies ranked by Elo or Glicko.

system.description: Ranking system to use. Defaults to elo.

limit.description: Maximum number of movies to return (default 20).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call.

tools.name: get_movie_details
tools.title: Get Movie Details
tools.description: Fetch detailed metadata for a single movie by movieId, including global ratings and your own status. Use search_movies first when you only have a title.

movieId.description: Firebase movie id for the movie you want details for.
